label: PF Backlog 368
title: ENG-8: INTEGRATION execution
body:
## Also required (from PR-merge enforcement review)
- CI must run the FULL precheck as a REQUIRED check (today .github/workflows/structure.yml omits api-contract, api-governance, lint, engineering-flow/task-contract/scheduler/vcs-worktree/worker/validation-engine/feature-pr, intent-trace, secret-scan).
- The merge gate / integration queue must require a PASSING precheck AND FEATURE_PR (feature_pr) result before allowing a merge to develop; non-PASS => blocked.
- Document + require GitHub branch protection (required status checks + no force-push) so a red check blocks merge.
